trailhead.label: Cristauta car park, above Santa Cristina, the board’s start

cautions: At the Seceda top station the ridge path beyond runs along a sheer north face: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Cattle graze the Mastlé and Seceda pastures in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
